## d3 v0.0.1

:::{.column-page}

### Interactive Map


  <iframe src="d3/index_0.0.1.html" 
          frameborder="0" 
          style="width:800px; height:60vh; border:none; display:inline-block;">
  </iframe>

---

Visualizes NOAA Coral Reef Watch DHW (Degree Heating Weeks) data from a NetCDF4 .nc file as an interactive global map using D3.js and h5wasm.

1.  Load Libraries: • Uses h5wasm to read HDF5/NetCDF4 files directly in the browser. • Uses d3 for data-driven map visualization.

2.  Load Remote DHW Dataset: • Fetches a daily NOAA CoralTemp NetCDF file for March 30, 2025. • Saves it as "dhw.nc" in the browser’s virtual file system.

3.  Parse NetCDF File: • Opens the file with h5wasm.File(...). • Extracts: • degree_heating_week values • Latitude (lat) and longitude (lon) dimensions.

4.  Extract GeoJSON Points: • Iterates through every 20th pixel to reduce density. • Skips invalid or missing values. • Creates a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of points with: • Coordinates • DHW values

5.  Render with D3: • Sets up a geoNaturalEarth1 map projection. • Draws each point as a colored circle scaled by DHW. • Color uses the YlOrRd (Yellow–Orange–Red) gradient.

6.  Add Tooltip: • Shows lat, lon, and DHW on hover.

7.  Add Legend: • Horizontal color bar showing DHW scale from 0–12 °C-weeks.
